analysis_mode: Captured JSON and NPZ only, no model or source import, initialization, or regeneration.

donor_only_instrument_check.interpretation: The selected donor alone violates its required same-probe scalar gate in 17 cases. Each current affected set also has failing sham probes; donor-only refers to a sufficient selected-vector obstruction, not exclusive failure attribution.

formulas.telescoping_identity: D Q32N - D QP = application_component + state_hessian_component + native_estimator_component

inference_limits: All findings concern one frozen untrained model and eight independent input bases with eight correlated goals each.
The broad derivative agreement gate and strict scalar curvature resolution gate measure different tolerances and can have different outcomes.

Donor probe failures hold the reached state, model tensors, and representable directional input fixed across dtypes. Their scalar arithmetic discrepancy is independent of sham selection and clean-state drift.
The donor ceiling is conditional on the fixed selected donors and frozen native oracle. It is not a ceiling for a different precision, dose, donor definition, or protocol.

The decomposition follows the declared application-then-state-then-arithmetic path. Components are signed, can cancel, and can overlap in case-level failures; component exceedance counts are not mutually exclusive causal shares.

The state term compares the captured promoted FP64 HVP at h32.double() with the captured dense Hessian at h64 on identical physical vectors. It isolates this numerical clean-state change along the declared path.
The native estimator term includes native HVP arithmetic and directional input casting. Both are separately computed from archived HVP vectors.
The source-only controls were not used to score edited task correctness. These numerical findings do not establish a trained-model causal reasoning mechanism.
Per-vector and per-case distributions describe this capture; no population confidence interval or independent replication claim is made.

notation.D: Sham quantity minus the same case selected-donor quantity.
notation.H32_v: Archived native FP32 HVP at h32 on v.float(), lifted to FP64.
notation.H_N_deltaN: Archived fresh promoted FP64 HVP at h32.double() on exact deltaN.
notation.H_N_v: Archived fresh promoted FP64 HVP at h32.double() on v.
notation.H_P: Archived symmetric 96x96 FP64 coordinate Hessian at reference h64.
notation.deltaN: Exact FP64 difference after FP32 addition at actual native h32.
notation.deltaP: Exact FP64 difference after FP32 addition at reference h64.float().
notation.v: deltaN.float().double(), the lifted representable native HVP input.

quantile_method: NumPy linear interpolation; pooled vectors and case maxima are descriptive and correlated.
